description: This is the entry point for a React-based frontend application, responsible for rendering the root React component into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for the React application to render into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the specified React elements (here, <React.StrictMode><App /></React.StrictMode>) into the root DOM node.
